findings.action_taken: Expanded the canonical owner schema to preserve all existing projection fields and byte-stable render compatibility.
Added normative enum members, exact immutable value schemas, invariants, and canonical encoding rules.
Added exact common ownership and per-event required field schemas including all metric producers.
Defined physical task/run state paths, deterministic task branch, Git-derived identity, and real branch/worktree resume checks.
Defined two-stage validation, one terminal dispatch decision, and exact predecessor/successor event semantics.
Added same-session nonce challenge, trust/hash/session evidence, same-tool rewrite limit, and fail-closed unsupported-class admission.
No edit: existing scope and terminal rules already require later authority and prohibit a false black-box pass.
Added a 25-row owner descriptor artifact; 19 rows are grounded and six named custodian contracts are an explicit pre-implementation gate.
Versioned predecessor and successor by registry, operation, source bundle, and changed-artifact hashes.
Defined budget dimensions, atomic reservation, lease/release/reconciliation, concurrency, and per-dimension boundary tests.
Froze the corpus manifest, six-run/40-action sufficiency floor, strata, window, and mutation rejection before measurement.
Replaced false cross-file atomicity with a ledger commit point and deterministic stale-view repair.
Defined an opaque controller-only capability and CLI plus Python call-graph/AST migration checks.
Aligned new events to recorded_at_utc and persisted canonical typed parameters with secret handles only.
Removed the invented local branch and made TaskBranchSnapshotWriter plus the acknowledged task/<task_id> snapshot the sole durable authority.
Assigned capability-manifest and nonce production to the mcp-agents-workflow launcher using the exact invoked Codex config and live hook challenge.
Defined ParameterValue, TypedParameter, BudgetRoleId, and multi-parent OwnerSpec semantics.
Demoted owner-descriptors.json to evidence inventory and materialized a schema-versioned 25-row migration manifest with unique evidence pointers and closed contract ids.
Located checked-in authorities for all six prior custodian rows and bound every owner to a manifest row and frozen evidence pointer.
Defined ordered OperationSignature, CompatibilityKey, and total successor parameter mapping rules.
Defined duration capacity production and explicit unsupported semantics for absent token/monetary authorities.
Made recurrence eligibility controller-derived, raw bypass host-observed, registered use decision-derived, and timing union-based.
Added per-child durable effect graphs and reconciliation for composite owners.
Replaced the memory-only/MAWF-only path assumption with exact production source binding, raw observation, six-proof admission, ten-owner source-path acceptance, and bounded MCP source/test paths.

Fixed prevention_source_probes.py, ProductionSourceProbeBackend, the immutable owner/profile provider factory map, true-edge-only injection, controller construction, and production-proof rejection of test transports.
Made the required profile set materializer-derived and required every mechanically applicable proof kind per profile.
Replaced trusted scalar PASS strings with canonical trace artifacts that the materializer replays and semantically validates.
Separated contract_verification from dispatch_admission and fixed MAWF as VERIFIED plus PARENT_GATED using a real source path and legal same-journal parent fixture.
Aligned the Greenfield writable set exactly to its four approved proposal sources and made mcp_server.py a read-only dependency.
Added a closed exact focused-test list for every owner and bound the approval boundary to those paths.
Made OwnerRuntime the sole owner of the closed production builder after verified preparation and removed every production backend/transport/factory injection point.
Removed the self-hash field and made the proof reference/filename the SHA-256 of complete canonical trace bytes.
Expanded every MCP source, read-only dependency, and focused test to an absolute path and named the exact memory acceptance test in each row.
Added the auth owner sequence authority as an exact absolute read-only dependency.
